steps.name: Respected teacher (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Baynon] in “Kali,” go to [Narsha] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: This is the slab. thanks.
(Baynon takes the slate and looks at it here and there.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does anything come to mind?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Before I was born into this body, I was a resident of Knossos.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: And followed him from Freios to Eastland... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Probably that was the time when the Kingdom of Moss was defeated in the Battle of Freios and came to Eastland... .
(Baynon's pupils seem to have relaxed and become unfocused.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beynon? Wake up, Baynon!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, Medea?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, step aside. I'll try it.
(Medea takes a deep breath and taps Beynon’s shoulder with the staff she was holding.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wake up, Baynon.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It doesn't work. I'm sorry, Baynon. Please be patient.
(Medea raises her staff again and swings it towards Beynon's abdomen.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Kyaaa!! Baynon, why did you fly all the way here?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Beynon is fine, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is it really okay….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You have been to Pasiphae.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, at Beynon's request.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, that reminds me of the kid with the golem. Maybe what came to visit that child was... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know what Talos' plan is yet, but it will have an impact on the child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and take a look.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… . Then I'll find out more about what I can do with this slab.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, Baynon… . Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: … It's been a while so I let my guard down. I definitely felt his influence on this tablet by the way… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Because that's what he made it for.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea. But after he left, he felt different... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: … I'm preparing for 'night'. The day I will face him may not be right away, but when the time comes... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Phew.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I guess I should read a book today without thinking about anything else. Beynon, take a break too.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I was already thinking of Adventurer, but

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? why?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You helped me with my work last time, and I was sorry that I couldn't even say thank you properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: By the way, what brought you here today?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was someone who was worried about Narsha, so I came to take a look.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If you're not okay, you can't stay here. If it weren't for Madori, if it wasn't for the help of others... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer. I have something to ask. The person who said he was worried about me... . Do you have a similar appearance to me? Returning home like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. He leads a clan called Kali on another continent.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Are you Medea, a superhuman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, you know Medea’s name?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I heard the story from the professor. They say that, unlike ordinary people, there are people who protect many people with great power.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm just thankful that someone like that cares about me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, have you been to Knossos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know that? I recently went to Knossos for work.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I guess there's a story about him, and there's also someone who came to visit me last time, so... . I had a feeling that maybe he had been there.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer. Please tell us about your visit to Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I was curious about that place. Then briefly… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain the scenery seen in Knossos to Narsha.)
(I am reminded of Narsha's expression as she listens to the story of Knossos. Seeing her eyes sparkle, it seems like she is obsessed with something.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow, wow... . Wow!!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Golem? There are golem-shaped rocks?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. It was there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, I like it so much. Should I get something and bring it to you? I'll have to ask Talos about Narsha one more time as I go.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, would you like me to get you something from Knossos?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes? yes?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, yes, yes, yes, yes, yes!!
(Narsha's eyes are so bright that I can't even look at them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels like beams are coming out of the eyes.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Teacher, I respect you!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Teacher?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, teacher! You're great! Then I'll wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… , teacher... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I will go because the president called me. So, teacher, be careful!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, then should we go to Knossos again? I should go and ask Talos first.)

steps.name: Respected teacher (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Minos] in “Acro's Coffin” and obtain <Suspicious Electric Cable>. Then, report the quest to [Narsha] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I told him to come often, but he came so often that it was really annoying. As expected, you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After all, I'm not really interested in you. I'm just here because I have a question, so please just answer my question.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hahahaha. I was the one who asked you to visit often, so I have nothing to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I came to Talos is because I have something to ask... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: So I have nothing to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, I was secretly annoyed last time, but this time I'm openly annoyed...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Listen to what people say…!!)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's a shame, it would be more fun if you just say your thoughts out loud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (shudder)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, you… . What were you trying to do by taking away the magic golem?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Magic golem? I'm not sure what you're talking about?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: … Is it him?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that a man with animal ears came out of Knossos and came to the Guild Alliance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And besides Minos, who cannot come out, there is only one animal-eared man left in Knossos, and that is you.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh, really? Detective %s It's time to die. But what if that’s not me?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Stop because I don't want to hear any more.
(Talos covers his ears on top of his head with one hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Well, since the ears are over there, it's natural to block them... Ah, I feel bad.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I think you need something, but instead of going to me, go to the Beast King running rampant inside.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you treat it right, it will give you something good on its own. He's a bit of a pain in the ass. Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Phew.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well then, I'll just leave. Aquila and Nakun come and go and clean up the trash instead of picking it up.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Those guys... . They just make a fuss and it's really annoying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like a manager is a manager in a different sense. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I told you to go to Minos, so let's go to Acro's coffin.
(As soon as you enter Acro's coffin, Minos walks slowly as if he was waiting.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: The goddess responded when she saw you coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I haven't found a way for Minos and Pasiphae to go outside yet.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It's okay. If I had found it easily, I would have destroyed this place first and left.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I would like to express my gratitude for visiting this place again.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So what brought you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Hmm, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It's okay to tell me. If I can help, I will. Even the goddess said it was okay... .

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: (You can tell Minos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris?)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: … I can hear the voice of the goddess. Amazing. Being with you makes things clearer and clearer... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Medea, or rather, as Medea said, Eastland can be easily reached, but it doesn't seem to be Freios yet.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: An ominous power different from that of a god abounds in Freios and other places... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Medea, Medea... He called me… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You don't know? hmm… . That's like the child's childhood name. That's the name Daphne used to call me.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Anyway, tell me why you are here now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He says that there is a girl in the human village who handles magic golems, and that he is looking for something to give to the girl.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: One of the golems is with that girl in the human village... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Perhaps that child looks just like me and Pasiphae. Then it would be our clan.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I don't know how that child ended up with the humans and got hold of that golem... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: %s, anyway, I have something worth giving to that kid... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Come on!

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: If you want something, you just have to pay the corresponding price. If sparring with me for a moment is the price you pay, wouldn't you be lucky?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I will be waiting at the end of Acro's coffin. then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Minos?
(As soon as Minos finishes speaking, his image disperses and disappears like an illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The two of them only talk about what they want to say and fight, so it seems like they are a couple.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. Let's go quickly.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It was fun. Now, give this to the child.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This looks like a wire... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: In ancient times, we created this from a golem that fell from the sky. It is also called a cable, but we called it a mental string.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: This is what makes the golem move... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I don't know what he'll do when he sees this, but it might help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Minos.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It was just something I had. Now, go back.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And come back again. Only then will we be able to trust each other.
(Minos looks satisfied.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I've only not seen Pasiphae for a few days, and it's frustrating. What on earth was he so afraid of that he locked us up? .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh, teacher. Are you here?! I waited!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not used to that name yet... . First of all, take this. I don't know if it will help... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wow, wow!
(Narsha receives an electric cable from %s with sparkling eyes.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The person who gave this to me said he made it after looking at a golem that fell from the sky. AKA the string of the mind… .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It seems like something could be done if the parts were put together and connected to a cable like this. I should try making it with anise.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Wait a minute, could it be some golem that fell from the sky that Adventurer dealt with?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure about that.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm, this is difficult. teacher… . By the way, how did the person who gave this come to be?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Could it be with me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I have similar ears to Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: … I want to meet you later when the time comes. After listening to their stories, I want to continue meeting them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It will definitely happen that way.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you for your concern, sir. If you need anything in the future, please let me know. I will help you in any way possible.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Maybe there's something you're looking for in the information about Madori and Golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Narsha. Okay, I'll go.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh… ?!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I think it might be connected to the parts you found at that time. Let's give it a try!
